title: Measures to Assist Employees Affected by COVID-19 and Digital Disruptions
what_it_is: Measures to Assist Employees Affected by COVID-19 and Digital Disruptions

sections.label: Manpower questions on vacancies and workers
sections.summary: Questions to the Minister for Manpower cover unfilled job vacancies, employment and training assistance, and assistance for senior workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower in respect of job vacancies being at an all-time high of 92,100 in June 2021 (a) how many of these vacancies are not filled after six months; and (b) how can the Ministry help Singaporeans fill these vacancies for firms as soon as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) what kinds of employment and training assistance are given to workers to cope with the structural changes in the economy such as the digital disruption; (b) how many workers have been given such employment assistance; and (c) which sectors do these workers predominantly work in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) how many seniors aged 60 years and above are getting the Ministry's assistance to help them hold on to their jobs; (b) what are the forms of assistance rendered to these senior workers; (c) how many of them need to pivot to jobs in other industries; and (d) what are the main hurdles that they have to overcome.

sections.label: Questions on mid-career PMET schemes
sections.summary: Questions ask for updates on career conversion and job matching for mid-career PMETs, outcomes, frictions and upcoming support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry can provide an update on the progress of the various career conversion and job matching efforts for mid-career PMETs; (b) whether the schemes have achieved the intended outcomes; (c) what are the frictions; and (d) what are the other upcoming support and initiatives.

sections.label: Local jobseekers placed in opportunities
sections.summary: About 128,000 local jobseekers were placed into jobs and skills opportunities as at end-July 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Thanks to the effort of our tripartite partners and the National Jobs Council, around 128,000 local jobseekers have been placed into jobs and skills opportunities as at end-July 2021.

sections.label: Jobs Support Scheme disbursements
sections.summary: The Jobs Support Scheme disbursed more than $27.6 billion as of September 2021, mostly to hardest-hit sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Jobs Support Scheme has disbursed more than $27.6 billion as of September 2021, with most support going towards the hardest-hit sectors.

sections.label: Retrenchment numbers decreased
sections.summary: Retrenchment numbers improved since the fourth quarter of 2020 and decreased to 2,340 in the second quarter of 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Retrenchment numbers have improved since the fourth quarter of 2020 and have decreased to 2,340 in the second quarter of 2021.

sections.label: Businesses supported to hire locals
sections.summary: From September 2020 to May 2021, 58,000 businesses were supported to hire more than 400,000 locals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: From September 2020 to May 2021, we supported 58,000 businesses to hire more than 400,000 locals.

sections.label: Senior worker employment and support
sections.summary: Employment rate for those aged 60 and above rose slightly from 38.5% in 2019 to 39% in 2020, and the Government introduced a $1.5 billion Senior Worker Support Package in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Notwithstanding the recession, the employment rate of those aged 60 and above increased slightly from 38.5% in 2019 to 39% in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As mentioned in my response to Ms Yeo Wan Ling and Ms Jessica Tan just now, the Government has introduced the Senior Worker Support Package in 2020 with a budget of $1.5 billion to support employers in hiring and retaining senior workers over three years.

sections.label: Unfilled job vacancies 2020
sections.summary: Data from 2020 show about 27% of job vacancies were unfilled for six months or more.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Our latest available data from 2020 show that about 27% of job vacancies were unfilled for six months or more.

sections.label: Outcomes of CCP placements
sections.summary: About nine in 10 people placed through CCPs remained employed after 24 months, and about seven in 10 earned more than their last drawn salaries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: About nine in 10 of the people placed through CCPs remained employed after 24 months and about seven in 10 earned more than their last drawn salaries.

sections.label: Industry 4.0 Human Capital Initiative
sections.summary: WSG and SBF launched the IHCI to help companies trial and adopt Industry 4.0 technologies and develop workforce digital competencies, with close to 90 companies on board and 210 more expected by September 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To help workers and companies ride on the opportunities presented by Industry 4.0 to transform and digitalise, WSG has partnered with the Singapore Business Federation (SBF) to launch the Industry 4.0 Human Capital Initiative (IHCI) to encourage companies in these sectors to trial and adopt Industry 4.0 technologies early while developing their workforce's digital competencies to ensure that workers can grow alongside their companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Thus far, close to 90 companies have come on board the IHCI, with an additional 210 expected to do so by September 2022.

sections.label: TeSA, JTMs and tech jobs
sections.summary: IMDA's TeSA has placed and trained over 10,000 locals in tech jobs since 2016, and close to $10 million was set aside for Jobs Transformation Maps, with three launched.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: IMDA's TechSkills Accelerator (or TeSA) initiative serves to meet this demand, having placed and trained more than 10,000 locals in good tech jobs since 2016, with 2,500 placed last year in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I know that business and workforce transformation can be daunting.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: That is why we have set aside close to $10 million to develop Jobs Transformation Maps (JTMs).

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: They serve as a useful compass for employers, in particular our SMEs, and workers to prepare themselves for future jobs and skills.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have already launched three JTMs: Human Resources, Logistics and Financial Services.

sections.label: Identifying in-demand skills for training
sections.summary: Under ITM planning, MOM and MOE work with sector agencies to identify emerging and in-demand skills so training providers and IHLs can refine course offerings for industry needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To his first question, as part of the Industry Transformation Map (ITM) planning, MOM and MOE work very closely with the different sector agencies to identify emerging and in-demand skills for jobs in the various sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This will then enable the training providers and the Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) to refine their course offerings to make them more relevant, to make them more targeted and more specific for the industry needs.

sections.label: Skills for global talent marketplace
sections.summary: Efforts continue to help Singaporeans build skills relevant to the global talent marketplace, complemented by a targeted Career Conversion Programme that helped many take up new jobs in growth areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We must also sustain efforts to help Singaporeans build skills which are relevant to the global talent marketplace.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have complemented it with a more nuanced, targeted Career Conversion Programme and these programmes have helped many Singaporeans take up new jobs in growth areas.

sections.label: Targeted growth sectors
sections.summary: The targeted areas are growth sectors including sustainability and renewable energy, fintech, ICT and wholesale trade.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The key thing is that in the growth sector, in sustainability and the renewable energy sector, in fintech, in the ICT space, in the wholesale trade, in areas where there are growth, these are the areas that we target at.

sections.label: Unemployment and Jobs Taskforce study
sections.summary: Long-term unemployment remains among the lowest and resident unemployment is around pre-COVID-19 levels, and the Jobs Taskforce is exploring how widespread displacement and under-employment are.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: If you look at the headline numbers, our long-term unemployment continues to remain one of the lowest and even for our resident unemployment today, the numbers are, even though they are not at zero, it will never be at zero, but I think they are at a level that is round about pre-COVID-19 time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The next thing that we are exploring in terms of the Jobs Taskforce is to also investigate deeper to see how prevalent and widespread this displacement and under-employment that some Members think exists, would be.

sections.label: Career Conversion Programme outcomes
sections.summary: Nine in 10 placed through the CCP remained employed in the same company after 24 months, and about seven in 10 earned more than their last drawn salaries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For those who went through this, nine in 10 that was placed through this CCP remained employed in the same company after 24 months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And 70% of them, about seven in 10, actually earned more than their last drawn salaries.

sections.label: WSG placements into CCPs
sections.summary: Since April 2020, WSG has placed 14,000 locals into these CCPs through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills package alone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: If you look at it, since April 2020, just the SGUnited Jobs and Skills package alone, WSG has placed 14,000 locals into this these CCPs.
